//: Type-aware linting only — never used to build. `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` so they stay out of `dist/`, which would leave the tests and `vitest.config.ts` outside every TypeScript project. typescript-eslint's project service only discovers tsconfig.json, so it could not parse those files and lint failed with a parsing error rather than reporting anything. This project exists only to give the linter a program that covers them.
